title: The Mars Colony That Went Bankrupt for Less Than the Price of a Car

scenes.voiceover: A company that promised to colonize Mars went bankrupt for less than the price of a car.
scenes.mainText: BANKRUPT FOR LESS THAN A CAR

scenes.voiceover: Mars One said it would spend six billion dollars putting humans on Mars, funded by the biggest reality show ever made.
scenes.mainText: $6 BILLION. paid for by a TV show.

scenes.voiceover: The TV deal collapsed without filming a single frame. The launch dates slid from twenty twenty three, all the way to twenty thirty one.
In January twenty nineteen, a Swiss court declared it bankrupt. Debts of about a million euros. And in the bank, by one account, less than twenty five thousand dollars.

stat.label: DOLLARS LEFT — LESS THAN A CAR

scenes.voiceover: And almost nobody noticed. The world found out weeks later, from a post on Reddit.
scenes.mainText: the world found out on REDDIT

scenes.voiceover: How the dream quietly collapsed — the full documentary is on the channel. Subscribe to mindwired.
